description: SMES energy model with AC losses (Norris model), cryogenic cooling load (Carnot-based COP), self-discharge, and round-trip efficiency.

unit.name: Generic HTS SMES Unit, 10 MJ / 2 MW
unit.source: Buckles & Hassenzahl (2000) IEEE Power Eng. Rev.; Kalsi (2011) Wiley; Norris (1970) J. Phys. D.; Cigre WG B4 SMES studies.

I_max_A.note: Maximum coil current at E_max=10 MJ

k_ac_loss.note: AC loss coefficient (Norris simplified; ~0.1 mJ/cycle at I=100A typical HTS)

n_ac_loss.note: AC loss exponent (2-3 for HTS tape in Norris model)

f_ripple_Hz.note: Converter current ripple frequency (2*f_sw for VSC)

P_cryo_rated_MW.note: Static heat leak + base cooling at T_op_rated (50 kW for 10 MJ HTS SMES, Kalsi 2011)

T_op_rated_K.note: HTS operating temperature (20 K for MgB2 / REBCO with GM cooler)

COP_cryo.note: Fraction of Carnot COP for GM/pulse-tube cooler (typical 0.5-2%, Xue 2006)

k_cryo_T.note: Cryo load sensitivity to operating temperature variation

heat_leak_MW.note: Static conduction + radiation heat leak to cold volume (2 kW typical for 10 MJ system)
